

== Japanese Premiere printing (#172) ==
Full original PSA photograph and separate title/lower-symbol crops independently inspected. Title markers: 0; Credits coins: 0; no printed expansion or episode icon. The original source is retained as [[:File:Japanese-Premiere-sandcrawler-dark-PSA-original-20261106.jpg|the source photograph]]. The Japanese lore prints a length of 6 meters; the English printed face says 36 meters. Both give a height of 17 meters. The Japanese describes a livestock shed rather than the English warren-like home. Both game texts give eight passengers, Tatooine-site deployment, relocation only to planet sites, and +1 forfeit to Jawas at the same exterior site. Original printing ID <code>1301_309o</code> preserves the reconciled #172 identity and #166 source history. Citation preservation remains pending; GEMP implementation is not asserted. The English comparison uses the original Dark face in the retained video at 5:55, not the Light Side scan or the later bold errata face.
